zh.title: flydubai FZ1073 因機上安全事件轉降塔布克　阿聯主管機關調查中
zh.summary: FZ1073 於 9 月 30 日轉降沙烏地阿拉伯，GCAA 證實部分機組人員受傷，原因仍待調查。
body: 阿聯民航主管機關 GCAA 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日透過官方通訊社 WAM 證實，flydubai 自杜拜飛往特拉維夫的 FZ1073 發生機上安全事件，航機轉降沙烏地阿拉伯塔布克機場。事件已受控制，部分機組人員受傷並送醫。
Flightradar24 公布的飛行資料顯示，航班曾先後使用代表一般緊急狀況的 7700、代表非法干擾的 7500，隨後再切回 7700。這些電碼記錄不單獨構成事件原因或動機的調查結論。
GCAA 表示，調查團隊正與相關單位檢視事件的營運與安全面向，呼籲勿搶先推斷結果。Flightradar24 另刊載航空公司更新聲明，表示往返以色列航班在調查期間暫停；暫停措施沒有在該聲明中列出恢復日期。

en.title: flydubai FZ1073 diverts to Tabuk after security incident; UAE investigation continues
en.summary: The UAE GCAA confirms crew injuries following the September 30 diversion from a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight.
body: The UAE GCAA confirmed through state news agency WAM on September 30, 2026 that flydubai FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv had diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a security incident. The incident was brought under control; some crew members were injured and taken to hospital.
Flightradar24’s flight data shows emergency code 7700, followed by unlawful-interference code 7500 and a return to 7700. Those transmissions alone do not establish the cause or motive.
GCAA said its investigation continues. Flightradar24 also published an updated airline statement suspending flights to and from Israel during the investigation, without a resumption date.

facts.claim: GCAA statement dated 2026-09-30: FZ1073 Dubai–Tel Aviv security incident, diversion to Tabuk, crew injuries; investigation ongoing.
FR24 data: 7700 then 7500 then 7700; updated airline statement suspends Israel flights during investigation, no resumption date stated.
